reviews.text:
Jen was absolutely amazing with one of our hard to clip dogs. She was calm and patient and got it done so quickly that the dog didn’t even react to what was going on at all.
Lots of love and pets given at the end, even a few sloppy kisses from the canine client.

I’ve been bringing my labradoodle here for years and it’s hands down the best grooming salon in the city. Random people walk up to us all the time asking for our groomer’s info because our boy looks so handsome!

I love how Paw Prints is also a daycare, meaning your pet gets to lounge or play instead of being crated while they wait for you to pick them up. No stress, only vibes.

Overall, the staff here are lovely and you can tell they truly love animals.
Been getting my golden doodle cut and washed here for years. He always comes out clean and so cute afterwards
Thank you for the great haircut!
Very happy with my yorkie haircut 😃 …
Been going to Paw Prints since Theo was a puppy, they always do such a great job! It’s affordable, the people are lovely and Theo comes out looking perfect.
Appreciate the stars thank you!

Mr. Cheeto is a fussy little guy, especially when it comes to his nails and grooming over all. He’s been asked by groomers and doctors not to come back - dog blocked essentially, but paw prints always gets it done! Thank you for putting up with my fussy boy!

We have been taking our dog Emma to Paw Prints for over 2 years. Emma is a poodle terrier mix, rescued from Iran. We were a bit concerned the first time but the staff were so patient and skilled that she now loves going for her regular cut. Emma gets frequent comments from strangers on our walks who ask where she gets groomed.  We (and Emma), would highly recommend Paw Prints.
Thank you Rob!

We have been using Paw Prints for years and would highly recommend their services to anyone! Our dog Poppy is a rescue/chi-mix and always goes to the 'spa' reluctantly.  The Paw Prints team always takes very gentle care with him and he always has a bright personality at pick up. They also are so thoughtful taking seasonal photos and emailing them out - such a nice touch!

We had a wonderful first experience at Paw Prints! Our 1.5 y/o Schnoodle really struggles at the groomer - but they managed the best cut he has ever had!! We picked up a very happy - and very handsome - pup. Many thanks to the team for a great groom, we will be back!

Great experience at Pawprints Grooming Salon. They groomed my new foster dog, who is quite scared, and were very patient and gentle with him.

The staff took their time and made sure he was comfortable, which I really appreciated. He came out looking great and much calmer than I expected.

I would definitely recommend Pawprints

We had our two small rescue dogs groomed here and couldn’t be happier with the results!!  These anxious dogs had a rough start in life and needed to be handled with skill and care and that is exactly what was provided at Paw Prints Grooming Salon.  There is nowhere I would trust more with the care of any of my pets.  The owner and staff are true animal lovers, professionals who know what they are doing and will always do what is in the best interest of the dog.

Before v.s. After

- Shaved my dog bald for Christmas
- Didn’t do ear cleaning and plucking which I paid for
- My dog got ear infection after the service and had to find a vet

0/10 would not recommend, expensive and no skills, my dog has been shivering from the cold and scratching her ears all the time since the grooming.

Edit:
Several claims by the service are false.
The shaving was not discussed or agreed to beforehand. The photo referenced was an old photo, not my dog’s condition at intake. There was no ear-plucking service performed, despite the claim of a “partial” ear pluck.

What a dishonest and pathetic service, had to use the same text script reply to scam people.
👎👎👎😂😂😂

Dog groomers this good are a rarity!
My boy absolutely loves the owner as well.

I love Paw Prints! The staff are so friendly and knowledgeable, and are able to keep my old girl calm while she gets her nails cut (which she HATES). Highly recommended. I've also brought my younger dog in for daycare and she's always so excited when we arrive. It's so nice to know she's happy at daycare.

Update: We’ve since been back with our cat for a repeat visit and had another great experience. Same gentle, thoughtful care. Still highly recommend.

We had an excellent experience at this grooming salon with our Labradoodles! The staff was incredibly friendly and patient, and they clearly understand how to work with doodle coats. They listened carefully to what we wanted and did an amazing job—our Labradoodles came out looking fluffy, clean, and perfectly trimmed. You can tell they truly care about the dogs and take pride in their work. Our pups were happy and relaxed when we picked them up, which means everything to us. We will definitely be returning and highly recommend this salon to anyone with a Labradoodle or other doodle breeds!

At Paw Prints, the staff really want the best for your pets, so it should come as no surprise to learn that my dogs love Paw Prints and the Paw Prints experience. If they could talk, they would say, "It has to be Paw Prints. Every pet deserves to be pampered at Paw Prints. We hope to see you there."

The grooming itself is good, around $140 for a medium-sized dog. However, my dog hates going there and begs to leave every time something he never does anywhere else, which really worries me. On top of that, the customer service is terrible : the person speaks in a very rude and disrespectful way.

The staff at Paw Prints are always so kind and welcoming. They accept walk-ins for nail trimming, offer very reasonable prices and are very quick. I have multiple other dog groomers around me but I choose to go here because they are so amazing.
They do a great job! Fast, easy, and affordable. We really appreciate their services. We take our small dog in for nail trims and they always are so quick and do a fantastic job.
You groomed our friends dog Keno. You were so kind and Keno who has never been groomed before looked so good. Thank you. I have booked an appointment for my girl in a week or 2. Thx 🙏🏻 …

My babies always look and feel amazing when they come out. One of my dogs had an accident with a previous groomer, so I was nervous taking them to one again, but Paw Prints Grooming has been so good to my dogs and I couldn’t be happier. Thank you!
Paw Prints has been grooming our doodle, Finn, since he was a puppy. Haven't had a bad haircut in the almost 2 years we've been coming here!
Great and reliable groomer. I’ve been bringing my dog for years and they never disappoint.

I have been bringing my very senior French Bulldog here for nail trims for years, and I truly appreciate how gentle the groomers are with him. They always accommodate walk-ins, and the process is quick and stress-free. Recently, we adopted a 5-month-old Labrador Retriever, and it was time for his first nail trim with me. He’s already 86 lbs and extremely excitable, so I was nervous—his vet appointments have been quite challenging, and he even has a prescription for Trazodone to help calm him for these types of visits. When I spoke to the male groomer, he suggested trying the trim without sedation first to see how my puppy would handle it. I was skeptical, but I’m so glad I listened! Both the man and woman working were absolutely wonderful with him! They used treats to keep him distracted and offered plenty of encouraging words, which I know he loved. I was amazed that they managed to trim all four paws—I had expected we’d only get through one and have to return weekly! On the way out my puppy shoplifted a stuffed toy, and the woman kindly let him keep it (I am so thankful we didn’t have to involve the police :)  I was so prepared for this to be a stressful experience but my puppy had the best time and he is probably counting down the days until his next nail trim!

Paw prints is the best grooming service for your dog in Vancouver! My son/dog Casper is a Samoyed, he always shine and happy after grooming. They are very professional and for sure always doing a great job and very detailed. You will never regret to choose paw prints for your dog. The owner Jenn is so kind and with her beautiful positive spirits to operate her business. I am very appreciate with all her help, support and professional service. I love Paw Prints Grooming Salon ❤️😊❤️

I took my toy Schnoodle to this place for the first time, yesterday. I recently moved to Vancouver from North Vancouver and was concerned about finding a good groomer.
They seemed organized and were very kind. My dog, Paris, looked so cute and happy when I picked her up. They listened to my requests about the style I wanted, which is very important to me.
Today they emailed me a couple of cute photos.This was a such a nice surprise.
I am glad I found a great groomer for my precious dog!
Definitely recommend!

I just wanted to give a shout-out to the Paw Prints grooming team. I recently took my 10-year old collie in for a bath and fluff, and they were very gentle with my dog who suffers from arthritis. My dog came out beautifully bathed and trimmed!
Great!
Best groomers I have ever been to! My dogs look so great and actually enjoy the experience - very friendly and caring staff - highly recommend
You guys are amazing! Sometimes we have to take bingo else where for convenience, but nowhere else does it quite as good. Best in the biz!
They do such a lovely job! They’re very kind and gentle with my dog who I know isn’t the most cooperative. It feels good to take him somewhere where I know they’ll be patient with him.

We have been talking our dog to Paw Prints since she was a puppy, for over 2 years.
The staff always do an excellent job and our dog loves to go there. She can’t wait to go inside when we get close to the shop.
They are the most caring people and they take great care of our dog when she goes there for daycare too.
Also, our dog looks so adorable when they groom her.

In town to visit some friends and took my sweet senior dog here for some grooming. The staff was fantastic! My dog looked and smelled great after his appointment and was super happy with a big smile. I'd highly recommend the professionalism of this grooming salon for your fur baby.
Thank you for the stars!

Best Groomers on the Lower Mainland.

Paw Prints Dog Grooming have the most loving and gentle groomers I have ever taken my dog too.... We tried a few different places without much success before finding Paw Prints and have been brining our pup to them consistently for the last 4 years... I highly recommend their services to anyone❤️🐾❤️

Paw Prints Grooming did a fantastic job on a few of our dogs. I work for a local animal shelter in Vancouver and they have taken a quote a few of our dogs in for much needed grooms. Everytime I have gone the dogs have been treated with love and care in a fear free manner which helps keep them calm and relaxed. The groom's have been fantastic, the dogs are treated with love and respect and are never scared or stressed, before during or after the groom. We really appreciate that Paw Prints goes out of its way to help local pups, a good groom goes a long way to finding them a new home. Thanks Paw Prints your care means more than you know!!!

Gone here twice now for my 1 year old puppy and they have done a great job both times! I was worried because he doesn't let us trim his nails at home, but they were able to give him a bath, haircut, and nail trim no problem! Would recommend.

I’ve been a regular at Paw Prints Grooming Salon for a while now, and I can’t recommend this place enough! The staff and owner are incredibly friendly and always make me and my pup feel welcome. Their service is consistently top-notch, and my dog always comes out looking fantastic!

My Barb is a high stress chihuahua cross and this is the only place that I get her baths, nails and teeth done! Barb is afraid of water/ the rain and the groomers here handle her with care. One time I was in between jobs and my student loan …
I absolutely love this grooming service! It's the only place where Scott feels completely comfortable, and the results are always fantastic. His style is the best I've seen. Highly recommend!

BEWARE!
Have gone here a few times, and hadn’t had complaints. This time I noticed after I got home they had cut my dog, leaving dried blood under her arm. There was NO …

We have a ten-year-old Labradoodle dog, the big type, very sweet but very, very insecure with abandonment anxiety and does not like strangers approaching her, every time she needs to be groomed we are in trouble, I have no idea how many …

I had a fantastic experience at Pawprints Grooming Salon! I brought my dog in for both grooming and daycare, and I couldn’t be happier with the care and service provided. The staff was incredibly friendly, professional, and truly attentive …
